About Us
We are a rapidly growing engineering consulting firm with over 15 years of specialized expertise in structural, civil and stormwater engineering. We deliver precision engineering design and documentation services for residential (low to mid-rise), commercial, industrial and modular buildings across New South Wales.
Our reputation has been built on technical excellence, attention to detail and seamless collaboration with architects, developers, builders and consultants. Our mission is to provide practical, efficient and innovative engineering solutions that stand the test of time.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has become available for a Stormwater Engineer to join our growing team in Sydney.
You will be responsible for preparing stormwater management designs and supporting documentation for residential and commercial developments, while working closely with our structural and civil engineering teams.
The ideal candidate is motivated, detail-oriented, able to manage multiple projects, and committed to delivering high-quality engineering solutions.
Key Responsibilities
•	Prepare stormwater drainage designs for residential, commercial and industrial developments.
•	Design On-Site Detention (OSD), rainwater harvesting and stormwater management systems.
•	Prepare Stormwater Management Reports (SMR) and supporting engineering documentation.
•	Liaise with councils, architects, builders, certifiers and other consultants.

•	Ensure designs comply with Australian Standards, council requirements and relevant engineering guidelines.

•	Experience in stormwater engineering and drainage design.

•	Experience with Drains, MUSIC, DRAINS, HEC-RAS or other stormwater modelling software is highly regarded.
•	Good understanding of Australian Standards, Australian Rainfall & Runoff (ARR), and local council stormwater requirements.
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent communication and organisational skills.

Assistant Accountant 
Company: ITV Studios Australia
Location: Sydney, NSW
Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Salary Range: $80,000 to $90,000 Plus Superannuation 

About Us
At ITV Studios Australia, we sit at the heart of global television, creating and delivering some of the country's most exciting, talked-about, and high-quality entertainment. 

The Role
Reporting to the Senior Financial Accountant, you will enjoy a highly varied 360-degree assistant accountant role. You will take true ownership of core transactional processes, keep our cash flow moving, and play a vital role in month-end and compliance reporting. You will be heavily involved in maintaining statutory compliance, and advising on internal accounting workflows.

Key Responsibilities & Tasks
Financial & Statutory Reporting:  Assist with preparation of the  financial statements for presentation to management, governing and statutory bodies.
Managing the general ledger including preparation and review of balance sheet reconciliations, banking and management of intercompany transactions and balances
Accounts Payable (AP): Take full ownership of the AP process, reconcile supplier statements, manage approvals within delegated authority limits, and maintain up-to-date supplier records.
Accounts Receivable (AR): Create and maintain debtor master files, raise milestone invoices for productions and ad-hoc invoices, maintain the AR database, and confidently follow up on outstanding balances.
Credit Cards & Banking Daily Operations: Administer our expense management system, manage staff credit cards (including adjusting limits), and import monthly submissions with precise GL coding and GST accuracy. Handle daily cash balance updates and weekly production account transfers.
Production Recharges: Own the end-to-end recharge process to Productions, including raising invoices for credit cards and AP recharges, preparing backup documentation, and following up.
Month-End Duties: Reconcile Head Office and production bank accounts, handle AP/AR trial balances, post month-end accruals, manage the Fixed Asset register (depreciation & GL reconciliation), and complete intercompany reconciliations.
Compliance Support: Assist with GST, WHT, and BAS returns, look after Payment Times Reporting, help set up new users/accounts on banking platforms, and support the wider finance team during the end-of-year audit.
About You
To be successful in this role, you should have a solid foundation in transactional accounting and a deep understanding of standard accounting procedures.

We are looking for:
At least 12 months relevant work experience in a varied Assistant Accountant role (experience in media, television, or entertainment is a huge plus!).
Strong technical understanding of AP, AR, bank reconciliations, and general ledger coding.
Solid grasp of Australian tax compliance, including GST, BAS, and withholding tax.
High attention to detail and intermediate-to-advanced Excel skills (you'll be working closely with spreadsheets and Google Sheets).
Excellent communication skills—you’ll be collaborating with production crew, external vendors, and internal stakeholders regularly.
A proactive mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
Minimum Bachelor Degree or higher-level qualification in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline to satisfy the requirements of a professional Accountant role.

What’s on Offer?
The chance to work with a world-class, passionate, and fun media team.
A diverse role where no two days are the same—gaining exposure to corporate finance and production accounting.
Great office culture with opportunities for professional growth.

To Apply
If you are ready to take the next step in your accounting career with one of Australia's leading production companies, please click "Apply Now" and submit your resume along with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

As an ICT Business Analyst at HYDAC Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for analysing business requirements and improving the digital systems that support engineering, sales, inventory, service and operational workflows.
